name: TaxJar Automated Sales Tax
description: Automate US state sales tax nexus calculations, economic thresholds, and auto-filing for multi-channel sellers.
fullDescription: TaxJar (a Stripe company) takes the complexity out of US state sales tax compliance. By aggregating multi-channel transaction data across Amazon, Shopify, and Walmart, TaxJar monitors economic nexus thresholds in every state and automates return filings to prevent costly penalties.
features: Real-time economic nexus tracker monitoring state sales and transaction limits
Automated AutoFile service submitting state tax returns and remittances on time
Multi-channel transaction rollup categorizing marketplace facilitator sales
High-speed calculation API for custom cart checkouts with 99.99% uptime
Comprehensive audit-ready reports organized by jurisdiction and tax district
